label: UniProt GO Enrichment
description: For a pathway's enzymes that carry a UniProt accession, federates to UniProt's own SPARQL endpoint (sparql.uniprot.org) to retrieve every Gene Ontology (GO) term the enzyme is annotated with — molecular function, biological process and cellular component alike. PlantMetWiki itself carries no GO annotations at all; this is the live bridge to them.
